name: Authenticate, inspect readiness, and retain private workspace data
description: Verifies the critical owner flow and authenticated readiness.
steps: Refresh, sign out, and attempt private refresh
expected: Private records persist and signed-out access is denied.

name: Reject unsafe research destinations
description: Verifies local and private destinations are blocked.
expected: Unsafe URL is rejected and public source analysis can be saved.

name: Enforce private file controls
description: Verifies allowed files persist while unsafe files are blocked.
steps: Upload a small PDF or text file
Try HTML or SVG, then delete the allowed file
expected: Allowed file persists, unsafe file is rejected, and deletion remains after refresh.

name: Show truthful provider gates
covers: AppDeploy GitHub Drive Gmail Calendar states
description: Verifies provider links are not misrepresented as live connections.
expected: Only runtime-verified AppDeploy is Connected; GitHub and Google services show bounded evidence.

name: Keep mobile controls usable
description: Verifies mobile operation without unsupported readiness claims.
expected: Controls are usable and private actions require sign-in.
